fields.options:
When an admission fee is only partly refunded, the amount the institution keeps stays in the Admission Fee (Provisional) liability for that student. Booking it as income (from a Student Fee Refund, or the Student Fee Refund Income report) debits the provisional liability and credits the income account.

By default this is the per-company account Income From Admi Cancellation - {abbr} under Income → Indirect Income — create it once per company in the Chart of Accounts. The override below is only needed if you want a differently-named account.

fields.description: Optional override. Leave blank to use the per-company account 'Income From Admi Cancellation - {abbr}' under Income → Indirect Income. If set, this account is used instead — it must be a ledger (non-group) account belonging to the company the refund is posted under.
fields.label: Retained Fee Income Account (override)
